# Darren Helton

> Builds products from architecture to launch and leads the teams that ship them. San Francisco. Seven years at
> Linden Lab, leading growth, customer data and conversational AI for Second Life, the virtual world that defined the metaverse.

## Projects
- [AGEWARDEN](https://darrenhelton.com/agewarden/): age verification from seconds of speech. No ID, no face image, no stored voiceprint.
  Right 96.1% of the time on recordings it never learned from, with no minor passed; in production, 97.8% of adults
  pass. Live at agewarden.ai.
- [Covenant & Crucible](https://darrenhelton.com/covenant-crucible/): read US trade policy as it was published, across more than
  thirty government sources, and told importers and compliance teams what had changed. AI scored every document;
  alerts, tariff totals by customs code, and screening against 223,000 people and companies on sanctions and watch
  lists. Shipped as a web portal, an API and a daily email digest. The product underneath was forecast: twelve models,
  each trainable from records the government already publishes, to say what was coming, not just what had changed.

## Awards

  People's Telly, bronze Clio Entertainment award.
